source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB identity; source combines one-time/persistent, legacy/UEFI and five boot targets.

source_snapshot.procedure: Write 0x00/0x08 boot flags for one-time/persistent legacy/UEFI and PXE/disk/optical/BIOS/USB, restart and inspect BIOS within 60 seconds; generic log clear.
source_snapshot.criteria: Commands succeed, actual boot and option match setting.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, one option/mode per run.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Get Boot Options can read flags but cannot prove actual boot.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 preserves write/reboot coverage; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Set and verify each selected one-time or persistent boot target/mode, including actual firmware/OS boot behavior, then restore baseline.
original_method: One approved mode/device per run using validated 0x00/0x08 fields, readback, controlled restart, console observation and recovery.
manual_activity: Owner selects one target/mode and approves restart; operator validates media and recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Too incomplete; exact source bytes exist but require safe selection, readback, restart and observation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected allowlisted 0x00/0x08 writer/reader with console boot observer.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Test each boot tuple independently, decode readback, observe the real target and restore baseline; do not infer pass from raw success or 60-second wait.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-tuple gates/recovery without reducing coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readback alone cannot prove selected media actually booted.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Persistent or wrong target can strand SUT or expose data.

project_override_considerations: High-level bootdev tooling is equivalent only with exact flags, actual boot and restore evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master mixes many disruptive tuples, clears logs and omits baseline restore/recovery; DeepSeek discards the explicit bytes and actual-boot coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Commands and functional purpose are defined; selection, media and recovery are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Separates each boot tuple and requires actual boot evidence plus restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: Boot mutation/restart requires package and fresh confirmation, not permanent block or read-only substitution.
